<subject>Thornfield Utilities?</subject>
<body>
Antony,

Thornfield Utilities, acting for the Department of Water Regulation, will be inviting tenders for  
gas supply. We are considering minimal gas acquisitions and wish to establish a GISB agreement. We would like a brief update on the current status of the GISB contract between your firm and the Department of Water Regulation. If your legal team has any queries or reservations, please reach out to Dale Fletcher at Thornfield Utilities on +44 7817 646361.

To alleviate any credit-related issues, the department is finalising a full credit dossier, which we will send to you as soon as it is ready.

Please feel free to call at any time.

Kind regards,  
Judith Dennis  
Contract Administration  
Thornfield Utilities  
+44 7817 646361  
</body>
